What changes for us: x/net/html is imported only by internal/web's tests, which parse rendered pages, and is linked into no binary; http2, hpack and trace (grpc, so the Temporal client) and httpguts and idna (ogen's generated server) are unchanged, and the other packages that changed (ipv4, ipv6, quic, internal/socket) are linked into no binary. In x/text, the bidi rules W2, W5 and W7 and isolate matching became linear with the same results, and bidirule (pgx's SASLprep through precis) builds its ASCII table on first use; language, message, number and plural, which internal/web/i18n uses, are unchanged. x/crypto/ssh, which sftpclient uses with a pinned host key and the host key algorithms named after it, gains ML-DSA keys (built only with Go 1.27, so inert on our Go 1.26.10), encrypt-then-MAC for CBC ciphers (not negotiated: we set no ciphers and CBC is not a default) and ParseAuthorizedKey trimming only ASCII space and tab and dropping only a trailing carriage return: a well-formed host key line, with LF or CRLF, parses as before, but one with a vertical tab, form feed or non-ASCII space before the key type or straight after the key (when it has no comment) no longer parses, and since BankChannels.Endpoint re-parses a stored connector's settings, a bank_sftp connector saved with such a host_key would now be refused when it is used; chacha20, blake2b and salsa20 gain loong64 assembly only. x/sys adds x86 CPU feature flags and Linux syscalls and constants (Listns, PrctlArg5Ptr), aligns the Linux Getdents buffer to 8 bytes and moves darwin fcntl to a pointer call; go.sum also moves golang.org/x/term to v0.47.0, which only x/crypto's own tests import. Code and tests are unchanged.
